initialize.description: I build fast, scalable and client-friendly web applications with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Sanity CMS, TypeScript and Spring Boot.

workcases.title: saintsfilms
workcases.description: Institutional website for Saints Films — a professional audiovisual production company based in Brazil, PE. Developed with a focus on a strong visual identity, fluid animations, strong SEO, and a scalable frontend architecture.

about.title: about
about.description1: I started my development journey in 2025 with a strong focus on back-end engineering, studying Java, Spring Boot, APIs databases and software architecture.
about.description2: Later, an opportunity to work on front-end projects at Saints Films introduced me to a different side of web development.
about.description3: What began with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript quickly evolved into building modern applications with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, and Sanity CMS.
about.description4: My work is driven by simplicity, motion, and attention to detail. I enjoy creating creative and minimalist digital experiences where design and development work together seamlessly.
about.description5: Most of my skills have been developed through hands-on projects, freelance work, technical documentation, online courses, and continuous self-learning.
